::: {.callout-note}
## Source inspected
The public PDF was read on 20 September 2026. It is a 2014 training presentation, not a 1990s ministry record. It is one side of the 1993-versus-1994 starting-year conflict.
:::

## Identification

| Element | As seen |
| --- | --- |
| Title slide | “CSIL Presented by Paul Gauthier Individualized Funding Resource Centre Society and Spinal Cord Injury BC 3 part series May 8, 15 & 22, 2014” |
| URL | <https://www.ifrcsociety.org/documents/resources/slides/getting-started/SCI-Presentation-1.pdf> |

## Annotation

Material passages:

- Under “Pre CSIL?” the deck lists: “1. The Agency  2. ECPM Enhanced Consumer Participation Model  3. People paid themselves.”
- Under “The beginning of CSIL”: “Established by the Ministry of Health in British Columbia in **1993**, with people with disabilities in the forefront of the program design.”
- “The Pilot — 50 people tried it out.”
- “Who was initially involved? Collaboration between home support agencies, BC Ministry of Health senior staff and consumers.”
- Gauthier is labelled “Founder of CSIL.”

A later IFRC deck by the same speaker ([2015 Module 1](2015-gauthier-csil-module-1.qmd)) uses **1994** in otherwise similar sentences. This archive does not reconcile the two.
